browserMechanismReferences.qualification: Primary sources explain the Blink focus-transition and HTML microtask mechanism. They are not claimed as the exact source revisions of the CI browser binaries. Concrete runtime behavior is proved separately by native RED/GREEN artifacts.

documentFocusTransition.observation: Clears focused_element_ before old SetFocused(false); later dispatches blur/focusout and considers the next focus target, with reentrancy checks.

textControlChange.observation: The losing-focus path dispatches change when the text value was changed by the user.

htmlScriptCleanup.observation: When the JavaScript execution context stack becomes empty during script cleanup, a microtask checkpoint is performed. A microtask alone is therefore not a barrier proving the enclosing native focus algorithm has completed.
